item.title: Measles 2026 update: These states are seeing new outbreaks as rate of infections trends upward

item.description: The global market for hair extensions is booming and is projected to hit $14 billion in annual sales by 2028. What was once a niche luxury item for women is now widely available. item.title: Why Spotify’s developers haven’t written new code in more than a month
item.description: Spotify’s most senior engineers don’t type code anymore. item.title: This classic MTV website goes where Netflix dare not venture
item.description: Call it the day the music died. On December 31, 2025, MTV’s last music-only stations shut down forever​. The last video played on MTV Music in the U.K. was “Video Killed the Radio Star” by the Buggles—which was also the first video ever played on the original MTV channel in the United States back in 1981.
